sentences.en: I attributed the delay in delivery to a traffic jam.
sentences.zh: 我把交货延误归咎于交通堵塞。

sentences.en: It's not fair to attribute your failure to your parents.
sentences.zh: 不能把你的失败都怪到你父母头上。

sentences.en: His good health is attributed to getting plenty of sleep.
sentences.zh: 他的健康状况良好归因于充足的睡眠。

senses.zh: 把…归因于；认为…是由于 - 认为（文章、艺术品或评论）出自… - 将（品质或特征）加于…;认为…为…所有 -
